authority: This is the stable SmartFund stock-data contract. Database, provider adapters, workers, APIs and frontend views must implement this contract; additions require a versioned specification change.
scope: Yahoo-listed equities, including 2330.TW, AAPL, MSFT and NVDA. Yahoo stock-quote data is the minimum product scope.

permanentExclusions.rule: Never fetch, archive, quote, republish, analyse, score or expose excluded content.

freshnessPolicy.marketData: Database latest accepted observation must equal Provider Latest Available; calendar date is never the freshness target.
freshnessPolicy.filingAndEventData: Refresh on provider publication, filing, report date, effective date or change detection; do not fabricate daily updates.
freshnessPolicy.derivedData: Recalculate only after validated dependent data changes; store calculation version, as-of date and input provenance.
freshnessPolicy.unavailable: Provider-lagged, unsupported or permanently unavailable fields are classified and retained as explicit exceptions, never filled with guesses.

schemaStability.rule: Use canonical time-series/snapshot domains with metric identifiers and versions. Do not add one-off columns for every future ratio or score.

quoteData.note: Profile, statistics, financials, holders and selected analyst fields.

corporateEvents.note: Yahoo events minimum; official provider decision is required where Yahoo has incomplete structured coverage.

technicalAndIntelligence.note: Deterministic, versioned calculations; no duplicate price downloader.

restrictedYahooSurfaces.note: ESG, analyst/research and options data may be market-, subscription- or licence-dependent.

domains.historical: PARTIAL: coverage depends on market lifecycle.
domains.daily: PARTIAL: Production Daily exists only for onboarded markets.
domains.expectedRefreshFrequency: Intraday while provider publishes; validated Daily after market close.
